name: cover
prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Create ONE 1024x1536 PORTRAIT preschool coloring sheet based on this exact chapter cover. Preserve the recognizable bespectacled Elder hedgehog on the left and little PinPin on the right, looking together at a big open book on a simple wooden table inside a tree home. PinPin points to one BIG fern shape on the page; Elder looks kindly at him. REMOVE ALL TITLE WORDS AND ALL LETTERING including tiny book writing. Simplify to two large friendly figures, open book with just one large leaf on each page, one simple lamp and the outline of an arched tree doorway behind. Remove shelf clutter, maps, texture, foliage tangles and small objects. BLACK INK OUTLINES on fully OPAQUE PURE WHITE paper: every background and fillable region is solid white #FFFFFF, zero transparency. Thick smooth bold outlines, broad closed white regions easy for FOUR-YEAR-OLD crayons. Hedgehog quills are simple zigzag silhouettes with only a few big inside quill shapes. Elder round glasses clearly distinguish him from Papa. No grey, tonal shading, hatching, gradients, shadows, fur strokes, dense needles, color, captions, numbers, border or panels. Tiny black pupils permitted; all major objects white inside. Complete scene with print margins.

review.notes: Elder glasses, child and large fern book clear; all cover lettering removed, opaque white fills.
